cases.name: Mariame Toure Sylla
cases.about:
A vibrant and visible part of her neighborhood, Sylla is well-loved by her community, where she had been volunteering and teaching at a French immersion school for over a decade. Sylla's sister, Fatima Toure, said, "Mariame was simple people. She never has done something bad. She was a quiet woman. She was working as a teacher. She loves children. Children love her. She had a quiet life just going to school to work, just coming back home."

Her sister testified that Sylla moved to the U.S. in 2020 and found work as a teacher at the Dora Kennedy French Immersion School, where she ended up becoming very popular in the community.
cases.narrative: On 8/1/2025, her remains were found on a pile of rocks near a pond, nearly 20 miles away, in the 7300 block of Old Alexandria Ferry Road in Clinton, MD. Her body was missing a neck and a head and was “bilaterally amputated at both knees and shoulders.
